text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause serious side effects like birth defects and liver damage, as well as common symptoms such as headaches and a stuffy nose.

list.snippet: Serious birth defects: Opsumit causes severe harm to an unborn baby and must not be taken during pregnancy.
Liver problems: The drug can cause liver injury or high liver enzymes.
Fluid retention: Swelling in the hands, legs, ankles, or feet (edema) can happen, sometimes leading to breathing trouble.
Low red blood cells (anemia): You may feel weak, tired, or look pale.
Decreased sperm counts: The medication can affect male fertility.
Stuffy or runny nose, sore throat

text_blocks.snippet: Get medical help right away if you notice signs of liver problems (like yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, or upper right stomach pain) or signs of fluid retention and swelling (like rapid weight gain or trouble breathing). You can learn more about safety protocols at Opsumit Important Safety Information.
